dedupe_keys.name: iso tr 23689 2024 space environment space weather information for use in space systems operations

description: ISO/TR 23689:2024 is a technical report of global scope that gives internationally accepted descriptions of the main space weather phenomena, their sources and their effects on space systems. It is written for space system operations, including ground-based, on-orbit and deep space automated satellite operations, and for developers of software for space systems, designers of space systems and launch providers, so that operators and service providers use the same terms when space weather information is passed between them. Published by ISO in June 2024 as edition 1, it runs to 29 pages and is sold as a PDF or paper copy for 159 Swiss francs; a sample can be read in the ISO Online Browsing Platform, and a British Standards Institution edition is also listed. Caveats: it is a technical report, not a normative standard, the full text is paid, and it describes phenomena and effects, not giving data or thresholds. It supports consistent definitions of space weather hazards when building impact chains for satellites and space-dependent services; a related record is ISO space environment work summarised in the ECSS space engineering standards.
name: ISO/TR 23689:2024 Space environment - Space weather information for use in space systems operations
notes: The ECSS standards record is planned in this piece and is named in prose only.
